item.title: A setInterval() alternative for browser-based games
item.description: Don’t use setInterval() for your game loops. In JavaScript, timers operate in a non-guaranteed delay manner due to the single-threaded nature of the language in browsers. Asynchronous events such as timers and mouse clicks can only be executed when there is a gap in the execution.

item.title: How to add a code copy button to your Hugo template
item.description: Due to the way code snippets are rendered differently when they contain line numbers, implementing a code copy button will depend on whether or not you have configured your snippets to contain line numbers.
